children: NAPC Defense, Inc. reported first-quarter 2026 results with related-party revenue of $5.29M and net income of $775.54K, compared with a net loss of ($701.88K) in the prior-year quarter; diluted EPS was $0 for both periods — 10-Q Summary.
¹ Reported as “Revenue, Related Party”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) applicable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Income (loss) per share - diluted - common”.
Revenue growth was driven by related-party sales following the acquisition of CornerShot rights and licensing from Native American Pride, enabling domestic production and demonstrations.

The company continued a strategic pivot from treasure recovery into the defense sector, targeting law enforcement, U.S. agencies and overseas markets including a potential large Saudi order (~37,000 units).

Operational moves included establishing manufacturing partnerships for plastics and metals and a subcontract arrangement to manage Department of the Army/War (DoW) contracts; ammunition brokering channels are being pursued subject to U.S. approvals.
